title: Incident at the Window
question: Today, can Utterson draw his shut-away friend Jekyll back out into the world?
light: low sunset from the west, deep black shadows
palette: soot black, slate-blue court shade, sunset amber, bottle green, bone white
look: gothic anime, hard ink blacks, sharp cel shadows, gaunt faces
motif: the blistered door and the bright key that opens it

door_sunday.described: A narrow London by-street of wet black cobbles on a bright Sunday afternoon. Filling the picture stands the sinister two-storey gable block: its upper storey one blank forehead of discoloured, damp-stained grey plaster running the full width, its lower storey holding one low blistered door, its brown paint peeling in scabs, sunk in a shallow recess above two worn stone steps, the plaster around it scratched and grimy. A cold iron gas lamp stands at the kerb on the RIGHT. Low sunlight falls from the west at the LEFT, laying long shadows of the kerb and the lamp post across the cobbles and leaving the door recess in deep black shade.
door_sunday.landmark: the blistered brown door in its recess
door_sunday.route: across the cobbles from the gas lamp at the kerb to the blistered door
door_sunday.geometry: The establishing wide, from the far kerb at eye height: the grey plaster forehead fills the TOP half of the frame from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge. The blistered door stands at the CENTRE of the BOTTOM half, about a third of the frame's height, its two stone steps below it. The gas lamp rises at the RIGHT edge, taller than the door, close to camera. Wet cobbles fill the BOTTOM third between the camera and the steps.
door_sunday.ambience: a distant church bell, a light wind along the by-street, a sparrow on the gutter

court_below.described: A small enclosed paved court at the back of a London house, cool and damp, its flagstones dark with wet and green moss in their joints. The camera side is the rear wall under the three windows; facing it across the court, a low arched entry in a sooty brick wall leads back out to the by-street, its black iron gate standing open. Tall brick walls rise on the LEFT and the RIGHT, their tops caught in sunset. A strip of amber sky glows between the wall tops; the court floor lies in premature blue twilight. Low sunset light falls in sideways from the west across the top of the LEFT wall, striking the upper bricks of the RIGHT wall and casting the LEFT wall's long shadow across the flags in deep black. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.
court_below.landmark: the arched entry with its open iron gate
court_below.route: in through the arched entry, across the wet flags to the foot of the window wall, and back across the flags to the arched entry
court_below.geometry: The establishing wide, from the foot of the window wall at eye height looking across the court: the arched entry stands at the CENTRE of the far wall, a quarter of the frame's height, its open iron gate at its LEFT. The brick side walls run up the LEFT edge and the RIGHT edge to the TOP of the frame. The amber strip of sky fills the TOP edge between the wall tops. Wet flagstones fill the BOTTOM half from the camera to the entry.
court_below.ambience: water dripping from a gutter, a faint wind along the wall tops, a far church bell

jekyll_window.described: The rear face of a London house seen from the paved court below: a tall wall of soot-darkened brick with three tall sash windows in a row on the upper floor, each framed by pale stone sills and lintels. The middle sash is raised half-way open, a dark room behind it, a cream blind drawn up to its top and a cushioned window-seat just inside the sill. The LEFT and RIGHT windows are shut, their panes reflecting the amber sky. A black drainpipe runs down the brick between the middle and the RIGHT window. Sunset light falls from the west at the LEFT, gilding the top of the wall and the stone sills, while the room inside the open window lies in deep black shade. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.
jekyll_window.route: up the brick wall from the court flags to the half-open middle window
jekyll_window.geometry: The establishing wide, from the court floor looking up at the rear wall: the brick wall fills the frame from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge. The three windows sit in a row across the TOP half, each a quarter of the frame's height; the half-open middle window stands at the CENTRE. The drainpipe runs from the TOP edge to the BOTTOM edge between the middle and the RIGHT window. A strip of amber sky lies along the TOP edge above the wall.
jekyll_window.ambience: the court drip, a sash cord creaking, a far church bell

thoroughfare.described: A broader London thoroughfare beside the by-street on a Sunday evening: a row of shop fronts along the RIGHT with fresh-painted wooden shutters closed over their windows, a wide flagstone pavement before them, a granite kerb, and a cobbled roadway to the LEFT. Iron gas lamps stand along the kerb, the nearest one lit. Far down the street a church spire stands against the amber sky. Low sunset light falls from the west down the length of the street from the far end, throwing long shadows of the lamp posts toward the camera, with deep black shade in the shop doorways. Raking grey daylight from the LEFT, deep shadow.
thoroughfare.landmark: the lit iron gas lamp at the kerb
thoroughfare.route: along the pavement from the by-street corner past the gas lamp toward the far spire
thoroughfare.geometry: The establishing wide, down the length of the thoroughfare at eye height: the shop shutters run along the RIGHT third from the RIGHT edge into the distance, each shutter a third of the frame's height near the camera. The cobbled roadway fills the LEFT half. The lit gas lamp stands at the LEFT third, half the frame's height. The church spire stands small at the CENTRE on the far horizon under the amber sky in the TOP third.
thoroughfare.crowd: four Sunday strollers in dark coats walking in pairs far down the pavement
thoroughfare.ambience: a hansom's wheels and hooves far off, Sunday footsteps on the flags, a church bell
thoroughfare.place_state: sunset light along the shop shutters, the nearest gas lamp lit

shots.frame: Wide of the by-street as Utterson (Lank grey hair, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) and Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) walk in over the wet cobbles toward the blistered door
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame; Utterson and Enfield walk in over the cobbles and halt before the stone steps; Enfield's black walking cane swings at his side as the two men gaze up at the door; the walker goes in profile, a long stride, feet in the picture.
shots.camera: On the far kerb at eye height, twenty paces from the door, a 35mm lens; the low sun comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the blistered brown door in its black recess at the CENTRE of the BOTTOM half, its two worn stone steps below it. The grey plaster forehead fills the TOP half. Utterson walks in at the LEFT third, Enfield a pace behind him nearer the LEFT edge, and the iron gas lamp rises at the RIGHT edge.
shots.end: The blistered door at the CENTRE of the BOTTOM half; Utterson standing before the steps at the LEFT of the door, Enfield beside him nearer the LEFT edge; the gas lamp post at the RIGHT edge; long shadows lying across the cobbles.
shots.changed: the two men halt before door
source: when they came in front of the door, both stopped to gaze on it
shots.turn: an easy Sunday walk -> a halt before the door of a story they hoped was over
shots.why: Hooks the episode on Hyde's door, the motif; shows Utterson cannot pass it by.

shots.frame: Medium close of Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) before the blistered door as he speaks to his companion

shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Enfield's lined face at the CENTRE, his head a third of the frame's height, the top hat brim near the TOP edge. The blistered brown door stands behind him at the RIGHT third in black shade, and the grey plaster wall fills the LEFT half behind him.
shots.end: Enfield's face at the CENTRE turned toward the RIGHT third, his head a third of the frame's height; the blistered door behind him at the RIGHT third; grey plaster across the LEFT half.
source: We shall never see more of Mr. Hyde
shots.turn: the door's story feels finished -> Enfield says it aloud, which keeps it open
shots.why: States the hope the chapter will break; shows Utterson among men who want Hyde gone.

shots.frame: Medium close of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) standing upright beside the blistered door as he answers his companion
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame across the whole shot; Utterson keeps his eyes on the door and answers; his head turns toward the blistered door at the LEFT third
shots.camera: At his eye height, level with his face, standing a pace in front of him, a 50mm lens; the low sun comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson's gaunt face at the RIGHT third, upright, his head a third of the frame's height, the bowler brim near the TOP edge. The blistered door recess stands in black shade at the LEFT third of the background, and sunlit grey plaster fills the TOP LEFT corner of the frame.
shots.end: Utterson's face at the RIGHT third turned toward the door at the LEFT, his head a third of the frame's height; the black recess at the LEFT third of the background; grey plaster in the TOP LEFT corner of the frame.
source: Did I ever tell you that I once saw him, and shared your feeling of repulsion?
shots.turn: Hyde a closed story -> Utterson admits he saw him and shared the horror
shots.why: Reveals Utterson carries his own memory of Hyde; he hopes, but he doubts.

shots.frame: Close of Enfield (heavy jaw, lined face) as he takes in his companion's confession
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame across the whole shot; Enfield's eyes swing from his companion to the door; his head comes round toward the door at the RIGHT edge
shots.camera: At eye height an arm's length from him, a 85mm lens; the low sun comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Enfield's heavy-jawed face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, the dove-grey hat brim along the TOP edge. A strip of the blistered brown door shows at the RIGHT edge, and sunlit plaster fills the LEFT edge behind him.
shots.end: Enfield's face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, turned toward the door at the RIGHT edge; sunlit plaster at the LEFT edge.
source: It was impossible to do the one without the other
shots.turn: a casual remark -> a shared repulsion recognised between the two men
shots.why: The listener's silent face after the exchange; the memory of Hyde lands.

shots.frame: Medium close of Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) half-turned to the blistered door, his black walking cane lifted toward it

shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Enfield's face in three-quarter profile at the LEFT third, his head a third of the frame's height. His black walking cane rests at his side across the BOTTOM edge, and the blistered door recess fills the RIGHT half behind him in black shade.
shots.end: Enfield's face in profile at the LEFT third, his head a third of the frame's height; his black walking cane pointing into the door recess at the RIGHT half.
source: not to know that this was a back way to Dr. Jekyll
shots.turn: a stranger's door -> the back way into Jekyll's house
shots.why: Ties Hyde's door to Jekyll, the fact that worries the lawyer.

shots.frame: Medium close over the near shoulder of Enfield (dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) toward Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) as he proposes they enter the court
shots.motion: The camera holds over Enfield's near shoulder across the whole shot; Utterson speaks and turns his head toward the court entry at the RIGHT edge; his long black coat stirs in the wind along the by-street

shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson's gaunt face at the RIGHT third, his head a third of the frame's height, turned toward the camera. shots.end: Utterson's face at the RIGHT third turned toward the RIGHT edge, his head a third of the frame's height; Enfield's near shoulder and hat at the frame's LEFT edge; grey plaster above.
source: we may step into the court and take a look at the windows
shots.turn: idle talk at a door -> Utterson resolves to go and see his friend
shots.why: Utterson acts on his unease about Jekyll; the walk becomes a visit.

shots.frame: Medium of Utterson (Lank grey hair, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) and Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) walking side-on across the wet flags of the cool court

source: The court was very cool and a little damp, and full of premature twilight
shots.turn: the open street -> a cool shut court in early twilight
shots.why: Moves the friends into Jekyll's own ground, darker than the sky above it.

shots.frame: Medium view of the half-open middle window filling the frame, where Jekyll (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face, thick black hair under his tall black silk top hat, long deep bottle-green frock coat) sits on a chair just inside it, seen from the chest up above the sill

shots.end: Jekyll seated inside the half-open middle window at the CENTRE in his bottle-green frock coat, chest and face above the sill, his face turned down; the cream blind above him.
source: taking the air with an infinite sadness of mien, like some disconsolate prisoner
shots.turn: a row of blank windows -> Jekyll found there, a prisoner at his own sill
shots.why: Shows the friend Utterson came for, shut up and sad above them.

shots.frame: Medium close of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) calling up to the window, Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) a pace behind him at the LEFT third

shots.camera: At chest height a pace in front of Utterson, a 50mm lens; the sunset comes from the LEFT over the wall.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson's gaunt face at the CENTRE, lifted toward the TOP edge, his head a third of the frame's height. Enfield stands smaller a pace behind at the LEFT third, his face turned up. The arched entry glows faintly behind them at the RIGHT edge.
shots.end: Utterson's face at the CENTRE lifted to the TOP edge, his raised arm reaching toward the TOP RIGHT corner, his head a third of the frame's height; Enfield at the LEFT third looking up.
source: I trust you are better.
shots.turn: a silent watcher at a window -> hailed by his friend
shots.why: Utterson reaches out first; his warmth meets Jekyll's gloom.

shots.frame: Close of Jekyll (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face) at the half-open sash as he answers drearily down into the court

shots.camera: Level with the sill at his eye height, a 85mm lens; the sunset comes from the LEFT across the stone sill.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Jekyll's broad, smooth face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, framed by the raised sash along the TOP edge. The pale stone sill runs across the BOTTOM edge, and the dark room behind him fills the RIGHT half in black shade.
shots.end: Jekyll's face at the CENTRE, eyes lowered toward the BOTTOM edge, his head half the frame's height; the sash along the TOP edge; black room at the RIGHT half.
source: It will not last long, thank God.
shots.turn: hope he is better -> he says he is very low, and wishes it over
shots.why: Jekyll names his despair; Utterson's errand meets its first wall.

shots.frame: Medium close of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face) urging his friend out, Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) a pace behind him at the LEFT third

shots.camera: At chest height a pace in front of Utterson, a little to his RIGHT, a 50mm lens; the sunset comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson's gaunt face at the RIGHT third, turned up toward the TOP edge, his head a third of the frame's height. Enfield stands at the LEFT third a pace behind. Soot-dark brick fills the BOTTOM half behind them, and amber light catches the wall top at the TOP edge.
shots.end: Utterson at the RIGHT third, his open hand raised toward the TOP edge, his head a third of the frame's height; Enfield at the LEFT third, face lifted to the window.
source: You stay too much indoors
shots.turn: pity from below -> an open invitation to come out walking
shots.why: Utterson offers the cure, fresh air and friends; he believes it can work.

shots.frame: Close of Jekyll (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face) shaking his head at the sill as he refuses

shots.camera: Level with the sill at his eye height, a 85mm lens; the sunset comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Jekyll's broad face at the LEFT third, his head half the frame's height, leaning toward the opening. The raised sash runs along the TOP edge, the pale sill across the BOTTOM edge, and the black room fills the RIGHT half.
shots.end: Jekyll's face at the CENTRE, drawn back from the opening, his head half the frame's height; the black room close behind him at the RIGHT half; the sill along the BOTTOM edge.
source: it is quite impossible; I dare not
shots.turn: an invitation open -> refused: he dare not come out
shots.why: Jekyll's fear shows through his courtesy; something keeps him in.

shots.frame: Medium two-shot of Utterson (Lank grey hair, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) and Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) standing on the flags, exchanging a look

source: I would ask you and Mr. Enfield up, but the place is really not fit
shots.turn: a friendly visit -> two men sensing a house that shuts them out
shots.why: The listeners' silent faces after the exchange; the refusal sinks in.

shots.frame: Medium close of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) calling up good-naturedly to the window

shots.camera: At chest height a pace in front of him, a 50mm lens; the sunset comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson's gaunt face at the CENTRE, lifted toward the TOP edge, his head a third of the frame's height. His black coat fills the BOTTOM half, and the soot-dark brick of the RIGHT wall rises behind him to an amber top at the TOP RIGHT corner.

shots.turn: refused at the door -> Utterson stays on, talking from below
shots.why: Utterson bends to his friend's terms rather than leave him alone.

shots.frame: Medium close of Jekyll (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face, long deep bottle-green frock coat) at the half-open sash as his smile is struck from his face

shots.camera: Level with the sill at his eye height, a 50mm lens; the sunset comes from the LEFT across the sill.

shots.turn: a smile of welcome -> abject terror and despair
shots.why: The spike's first blow: something inside Jekyll seizes him before their eyes.

shots.frame: Close of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) staring up from the court as the terror at the window freezes his blood

shots.camera: On the court flags a pace in front of him, at his eye height, a 85mm lens; the sunset comes from the LEFT over the wall top.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson's gaunt face at the CENTRE, lifted toward the TOP edge, his head half the frame's height, the bowler brim near the TOP edge. source: as froze the very blood of the two gentlemen below
shots.turn: a friend smiling down -> a terror that freezes the watcher's blood
shots.why: The listener's silent face after the last exchange, held with no line; Utterson sees what his friend cannot hide.

shots.end: The shut sash filling the frame, amber sky reflected in the pane across the CENTRE; the black room dim behind the glass; the pale sill along the BOTTOM edge.

sounds.sound: a heavy sash window slamming down, a sharp wooden bang

source: the window was instantly thrust down
shots.turn: an open window and a friend -> glass between them

shots.frame: Medium two-shot of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) and Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) staring up at the shut window, then turning away together

shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame; the black boots stride across the wet cobbles past the worn stone step; the cane tip comes down on the stones beside them
shots.camera: On the cobbles at ankle height, a 35mm lens; the low sun comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the worn stone step at the RIGHT third, its edge scabbed with flakes of brown paint. Two pairs of black boots stand on the wet cobbles at the LEFT third, the tip of a black walking cane beside them, long shadows across the BOTTOM half.
shots.end: The worn stone step at the CENTRE, the black boots striding on past it at the RIGHT edge, the cane tip on the cobbles behind them.

sounds.sound: footsteps on wet cobbles and a cane tapping

source: they traversed the by-street
shots.turn: halted at the door -> hurrying past it
shots.why: An impact of their haste; the door is something to get away from now.

shots.frame: Full of the Sunday thoroughfare as Utterson (black bowler hat with a pale grey band) and Enfield (dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) walk out along the pavement past the shuttered shops
shots.motion: The camera rises above the kerb, across the whole shot; Utterson and Enfield walk out along the pavement toward the lamp; four strollers in pairs walk on far down the street
shots.camera: On the pavement at eye height by the by-street corner, a 35mm lens; the sunset comes down the street from the far end.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the lit iron gas lamp at the LEFT third on the kerb. The shuttered shop fronts run along the RIGHT third into the distance, Utterson and Enfield walking side-on at the CENTRE before them, and four strollers move small in pairs far down the pavement at the TOP half.
shots.end: The lit gas lamp at the CENTRE, Utterson and Enfield beside it on the pavement, the shutters at the RIGHT third, the church spire small under the amber sky at the TOP.
shots.crowd: four Sunday strollers in dark coats walking in pairs far down the pavement

sounds.sound: a hansom's hooves and wheels passing on the cobbles

source: where even upon a Sunday there were still some stirrings of life
shots.turn: the dead court -> a street with life in it again
shots.why: Only among other people can Utterson face what they saw.

shots.frame: Medium two-shot of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) halting by the gas lamp and turning to look at Enfield (heavy jaw, lined face, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband)
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame across the whole shot; Utterson turns full round and looks at Enfield; Enfield's head comes round to meet him
shots.camera: At chest height on the pavement three paces off, a 40mm lens; the sunset comes from the RIGHT down the street.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson at the LEFT third beside the lit gas lamp post, his head a quarter of the frame's height, half-turned toward Enfield. Enfield stands nearer at the RIGHT third, a head larger. Closed shop shutters fill the background across the RIGHT half.
shots.end: Utterson at the LEFT third facing Enfield at the RIGHT third, both pale, eyes locked; the gas lamp post beside Utterson; shutters across the RIGHT half.
source: They were both pale; and there was an answering horror in their eyes.
shots.turn: silent flight -> the shared horror seen in each other's eyes
shots.why: The two men admit with a look what neither will say.

shots.frame: Close of Utterson (long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, black bowler hat with a pale grey band) as he speaks beside the gas lamp
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame across the whole shot; Utterson speaks in a low voice; his head comes down toward his chest
shots.camera: At his eye height an arm's length away, a 85mm lens; the lamp glow and the sunset come from the RIGHT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Utterson's pale, gaunt face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, the bowler brim along the TOP edge. The lit gas lamp glows behind him at the LEFT third, and the dark shop shutters fill the RIGHT edge.
shots.end: Utterson's face at the CENTRE, chin sunk, eyes lowered, his head half the frame's height; the gas lamp behind him at the LEFT third.
source: God forgive us, God forgive us
shots.turn: a friend's errand -> a prayer for forgiveness
shots.why: Utterson names the horror as guilt; he has seen what he should not.

shots.frame: Close of Enfield (heavy jaw, lined face, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) nodding gravely
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame across the whole shot; Enfield lowers his head in one grave nod; his head comes up and turns toward the street ahead
shots.camera: At his eye height an arm's length away, a 85mm lens; the sunset comes from the RIGHT down the street.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Enfield's pale, lined face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, the dove-grey hat along the TOP edge. The shuttered shop fronts sit behind him at the RIGHT third, and the amber street glows at the LEFT edge.
shots.end: Enfield's face at the CENTRE turned toward the LEFT edge, his head half the frame's height; shutters behind him at the RIGHT third.
source: Mr. Enfield only nodded his head very seriously
shots.turn: a prayer spoken -> agreement given without a word
shots.why: The listener's silent answer; the horror is shared and buried.

shots.frame: Medium close of Enfield (heavy jaw, dove-grey top hat with a wide brown hatband) as he turns and walks on along the Sunday pavement
shots.motion: The camera pulls back from Enfield's face across the whole shot, widening to show the shuttered shop fronts and the lit gas lamp; Enfield turns and walks on along the pavement toward the far spire; his black walking cane swings at his side
shots.camera: At shoulder height on the pavement beside him, a 50mm lens; the sunset comes down the street from the far end.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS Enfield's lined face at the LEFT third, his head a third of the frame's height, turned toward the far end of the street. The shuttered shop fronts run behind him across the RIGHT half, and the lit gas lamp glows at the TOP LEFT corner.
shots.end: Enfield walking along the pavement at the CENTRE, a quarter of the frame's height, toward the church spire under the amber sky; shutters along the RIGHT third; the gas lamp at the LEFT third.
source: and walked on once more in silence
shots.turn: two friends who spoke -> silence that keeps the secret
shots.why: The world's answer: the street goes on, and the window's secret goes unspoken.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On Sunday, Utterson and Enfield stop again before Hyde's door.

lines.speaker: richard_enfield
lines.text: We shall never see more of Mr. Hyde.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: I hope not. I once saw him too.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Enfield laughs at himself: he never knew this door was a back way into Jekyll's house.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: I am uneasy about Jekyll. Let us see his windows.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The court lies cool and damp, sunk in early twilight, though the sky above still burns.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There, at the half-open middle window, sits Jekyll, sad as a prisoner taking the air.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: Jekyll! Jekyll! I trust you are better.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: It will not last long, thank God.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: You stay too much indoors. Take a turn with us.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: You are very good. But I dare not.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: Something holds him in that room.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: Then we shall talk from down here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lawyer will not leave his friend alone.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: That is just what I was about to propose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hardly are the words spoken before terror strikes the smile away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The blood of both men below runs cold. One glimpse was enough.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They came to draw their friend out into the world. Without a word, they leave.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In silence they walk the by-street, past the door where Hyde came and went.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Only in the thoroughfare, where Sunday life still stirs, does Utterson stop and turn.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Both are pale. Each finds an answering horror in the other's eyes.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: God forgive us. God forgive us.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Enfield only nods, and walks on once more in silence.
